verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Deepgram Voice Agent supports telephony bridging via Twilio, barge-in, and function calling for custom actions, but nowhere mentions DTMF keypress sending, IVR menu navigation, or voicemail detection/leaving capabilities. Since telephony is a supported use case, this axis is fair to ask, but no documentation or feature reference addresses these specific IVR/DTMF/voicemail behaviors.
